item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the Secretary of Agriculture and Forest Service to manage, protect, restore, delineate, and report the boundaries of the groves; these are ongoing administrative and land-management actions, with no substantive legal consequence performed by this segment itself.","evidence":"The Secretary of Agriculture is directed to delineate the location of such Giant Sequoia groves"},{"segment_id":"2","code":4,"rationale":"This segment inseparably combines a mandated later agency legal outcome—Interior must withdraw the groves from mineral-location and leasing regimes—with present, self-executing prohibitions on timber management and inclusion in the allowable-sale land base.","evidence":"The designated Giant Sequoia groves shall not be managed for timber production"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President assigns the Secretary of Agriculture ongoing management duties concerning proposed development and the Converse Basin Grove; any implementation occurs through later agency management, while the final sentence disclaims enforceable private rights.","evidence":"the Secretary of Agriculture shall assure that any proposed development shall provide for aesthetic, recreational, ecological, and scientific value"}]}
